title: How are you? — the honest answer

fn.en: Say how you feel and answer Are you…? questions.
fn.ru: Говорить, как ты себя чувствуешь, и отвечать на вопросы Are you…?
fn.kk: Көңіл-күйіңді айту және Are you…? сұрағына жауап беру.

can.en: I can say how I feel and answer “Are you…?”
can.ru: Я могу сказать, как я себя чувствую, и ответить на «Are you…?»
can.kk: Көңіл-күйімді айтып, «Are you…?» сұрағына жауап бере аламын.

tip.en: Short answers repeat the verb: Are you tired? — Yes, I am. / No, I’m not.
tip.ru: В коротком ответе повторяем глагол: Are you tired? — Yes, I am. / No, I’m not.
tip.kk: Қысқа жауапта етістік қайталанады: Are you tired? — Yes, I am. / No, I’m not.

voc: Yes, I am. / No, I’m not.

items.r: 📅 I have a lot of work

items.why: A short answer never uses the contraction: Yes, I am.

items.q: My mother ___ happy today. She’s sad.

items.s: It’s eleven at night and I want to sleep. I’m very ___. 😴
Can I have some water? I’m ___. 🥤
She isn’t at work today. She’s ___. 🤒
I can’t talk now — I have a lot of work. I’m ___. 📅

tts: I’m Peter. Nice to meet you.

acts.title: A long Monday
text: Hi. I’m Aidana and I’m not great today. 😕
It’s Monday and I’m very busy at work.
I’m tired — my son is ill and he isn’t at school.
My husband is at home with him. He’s fine, but he’s bored. 🥱
It’s cold outside 🥶, but my office is hot. I’m happy! 🙂

items.sit: A colleague says: “Hi! How are you?” You are OK.
You are very thirsty in a meeting.
o: Can I have some water, please? I’m thirsty.

items.sit: Someone asks: “Are you tired?” You are.
items.why: Short answers never take the contraction.

items.sit: Someone asks: “Is your sister a doctor?” She isn’t.
You call work. You cannot come in today.
A friend asks how you are. It is your birthday and you feel wonderful.

lines.s: No, I’m ___. I’m very busy today. 📅
And your brother? Is he here?

write.q: Write 5 sentences: how you are today, how one person in your family is, and two things you are NOT.
write.model: Today I’m tired and very busy. My mother is fine. My brother isn’t well — he’s ill. I’m not hungry, but I’m thirsty. I’m not bored: I’m happy at work.

speak.q: Answer out loud: How are you today? Are you tired? Are you hungry? Use full short answers.
speak.model: I’m fine, thanks. Yes, I am — I’m very tired today. No, I’m not hungry, but I’m thirsty.

lines: Hello. My name [is|are|am] Aidana and I [am|is|are] from Kazakhstan.
I’m twenty-nine. I have two [sisters|sister|a sisters].
This is my sister Aliya. [Her|His|She] husband is Turkish.
[Their|Them|They] son is four. He isn’t [Kazakh|the Kazakh|a Kazakh].
